description: Implement a runner that spawns a configured shell command as a child process, passing task context via environment variables or a temp file. Capture stdout (truncate to 500 chars for status comment). Enforce the configured timeout using AbortController or a kill timer. On timeout: kill the process and return a failure result. Exit code 0 = success, non-zero = failure. This is the adapter for claude, codex, and any custom command.
title: Generic command runner with timeout
